intro: Quotes from recent sermons, our monthly newsletter, and next steps for following Jesus between Sundays.

quotes.quote: When God saves us, He doesn't just save us from hell, He saves us to a family.
In many churches, especially the rural churches, we are very friendly with each other, but we're not family with each other.
Obscurity in the eyes of men is never irrelevance in the eyes of God.
God doesn't just save us for us to sit and wait for the world to pass us by. He saves us to go out and do something.
quotes.sermon: Why Every Christian Is a Missionary

quotes.quote: You don't have to be clever. You don't have to close the deal. You just have to tell them.
quotes.sermon: Why Every Christian Is a Missionary

quotes.quote: Do you have a Spain? If not, ask God for one.
quotes.sermon: Why Every Christian Is a Missionary

quotes.quote: We welcome one another because Christ welcomed us.
quotes.sermon: How Should a Church Welcome People?

quotes.quote: Strength truly lies in giving up your right and being a blessing to somebody else.
quotes.sermon: How Should a Church Welcome People?

quotes.quote: They won't remember the sermon. They won't remember the worship set. They'll remember whether somebody loved them and showed them love, whether somebody welcomed them in.
quotes.sermon: How Should a Church Welcome People?
